## [1.4.0](https://github.com/yann-soliman/morphe-patches/compare/v1.3.0...v1.4.0) (2026-09-16)

### ✨ New Features

* **leboncoin:** add ad removal patch ([#28](https://github.com/yann-soliman/morphe-patches/issues/28)) ([3f710bf](https://github.com/yann-soliman/morphe-patches/commit/3f710bf46912f2f0635161f9341b80df42fb82e5))

patches.name: Meteo Consult: disable video autoplay
patches.description: Open weather videos paused; manual play still works. Ad videos are handled by the cleanup patch. Meteo Consult 1.1.4 only.

patches.name: Meteo Consult: remove ads and subscription prompts
patches.description: Remove advertisements and automatic subscription prompts, including the end-of-forecast screen. Also bypass the Play installation check for locally signed builds. Meteo Consult 1.1.4 only. Does not unlock or extend forecasts.

patches.name: Keepcool: allow plus in email
patches.description: Allow + in the local email part without changing the input or login request. Keepcool 1.8.21 only.

patches.name: Keepcool: booking availability dots
patches.description: Show a green dot on calendar dates having at least one booking slot with a free place. Keepcool 1.8.21 only.

patches.name: Leboncoin: remove ads
patches.description: Use Leboncoin's built-in ad-free paths to suppress banners, native ads and interstitials. Supports Leboncoin 100.124.1 and 100.125.0.
